cases.title: Limpopo River Valley, Mozambique
cases.short_description: A wide dark corridor appeared along this irrigated river valley within 12 days. Inspect NISAR's L-band radar passes to uncover what happened.

cases.title: Krasheninnikov Caldera, Kamchatka
